items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I met my boyfriend John, we’re not together now, but he was a great alto player. We did two CDs together, did some recording.

ctx.x: That’s interesting. If this was an all-guy band and you had those same nationalities they would probably promote it as an international type band. But you’ve got two kinds of interesting identities to your band. It’s great.

But I was in a position when I first started playing and recording and I mentioned about Michael Moore and I did get a chance to play with him on a CD. I would never hire a woman, ever. It didn’t even occur to me to hire a woman when I first started like doing my own projects and I was actually in grad school and I met my boyfriend John, we’re not together now, but he was a great alto player. We did two CDs together, did some recording. Never would it even have occurred to me for any reason to hire a woman. I…
Let me ask you the question about you’re on a desert island and you can take five CDs or LPs.
